pillar_reactions.evidence: Call ended before any pillar was delivered; rep explicitly deferred it: 'I would take you through how we could actually help you' — next call.
Diet was surveyed in baseline but the nutrition pillar was never presented as part of the offer.

anchors.raw: after I paid thousands of dollars, , they're gone
anchors.note: She has already spent thousands on online fitness programmes, so a four-figure price is not novel to her. It cuts both ways — the spend proves capacity and willingness, but the outcome was abandonment, which is exactly why she is suspicious of anything sold to her over video.

anchors.raw: I've had gym membership all my life
anchors.note: A lifelong gym membership is her reference price for 'paying for fitness'. She was drawn to kettlebells specifically because 'it looks like the kettlebell is doable. You can do it anywhere' — i.e. the appeal was removing cost and friction, not adding it.
